string.name: phone_pair_ssh_key_help
string.value: Use the private key authorized on the SSH server. Its SHA-256 host fingerprint is confirmed before authentication.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_tls_help
string.value: Use the HTTPS Hub address on the pairing form. A pairing link supplies the Hub TLS public-key fingerprint (SPKI). For a typed address enter the 43-character fingerprint from the same Hub.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_public_help
string.value: Add the restricted line to the SSH server’s authorized_keys file to permit forwarding only to the Hub target. The private key stays on this device.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_confirm_peer
string.value: Check the fingerprint against the server’s host public key before trusting it.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_remove_help
string.value: This removes the tunnel settings. Remove the authorized_keys line on the server separately if you want to revoke its permission.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_target_help
string.value: Enter the Hub address as seen from the SSH server. Both services on the same machine normally use 127.0.0.1:18660.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_fallback_help
string.value: When off, this device tries the Hub directly and uses SSH if the Hub is unreachable.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_fallback_parent
string.value: Connect to this address directly first, and use the SSH tunnel if that fails.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_always_parent
string.value: Always connect to this hub through the SSH tunnel.
